name: Promenade Temecula
summary: Chain known for unique gadgets, gifts & lifestyle items, such as electronics & travel accessories.
description: Promenade Temecula is your go-to shopping mall in Temecula, California, offering an exciting lineup of the best brands in the market along with a variety of dining options for an exceptional shopping experience. Whether you're seeking retail therapy, engaging family-friendly events, or a delicious meal, this Temecula mall provides a comprehensive destination for entertainment and shopping with a Regal Edwards cinema featuring IMAX.
demographics: Promenade Temecula serves the rapidly growing Temecula Valley region, attracting predominantly middle to upper-middle class families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The primary trade area includes young families and millennials aged 25-54 who appreciate convenient shopping combined with entertainment options like the Regal IMAX theater. Visitors typically seek value-oriented mainstream retailers alongside dining experiences, with shopping patterns reflecting a family-centric lifestyle that combines errands with leisure activities in a single destination.
